entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're you bringin' us here for?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just do as I told you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, I've got the Phantom Aficionado[n]Website up. Now what?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look for a post with a full name in it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I already said there's no info on any big[n]shots. Don't you remember?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But man, people actually go put someone's[n]real name on here. That's some scary shit...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: "He won't listen to what I say"... No wait,[n]there's no name on this one.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "Someone's bad-mouthin' me in online[n]chat rooms"... This one's got a name.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ignore those. Aren't there any posts about[n]more serious trouble?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: "I don't know what to do about my ex[n]who's stalking me. His name is Natsuhiko[n]Nakanohara."

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It says he's a teller at City Hall.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A government worker's stalkin' someone?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That should be a suitable target.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, now get the Meta-Nav ready.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're just gonna jump right into a Palace?[n]Fine by me!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, what happened to all that talk of[n]"unanimous decision"?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What do you think we should do,[n][fName]?
Let's go.
We need to do this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's what I'm talkin' about!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay then. Let's go.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We need a name and a place, right?[n]So the name is...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Actually, we don't need a location this[n]time. Just enter exactly what I say.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The keyword is... "Mementos."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? What're you tryin' to pull?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just listen to me. It should work... I think.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Geez, that again?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uhhh... "M-e-m-e-n-t-o-s," was it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We got a hit!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just as I thought!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Everyone disappeared!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It... kind of feels like I'm... walking on air?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is this that Nakanohara guy's Palace?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's half right, but half wrong.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is a type of Palace, but it's different[n]from the normal ones.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, let's head down. The Shadows[n]here lurk underground.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I don't quite understand why. It may be[n]because they're drawn to something.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Underground? How are we going to[n]get there?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How? You use it every day on your way[n]to school.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Follow me!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ah! Wait up, cat!
